module: "Attention arrow" checkpoint marker: a blue arrow (model s_mm_arrow_ribbon_down.dae) floating above the point, turned toward the camera, with a vertical sway. The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/attention')(id) gives an object of class C. Used via scenario_race_marker (setupMarkers with the name 'attention') or directly.
notes: setToCheckpoint(wp) reads wp.pos (vec3) and wp.radius (arrow scale, 1.5 by default).
The color is fixed (0, 0.4, 1) regardless of the mode; the mode is only used to hide (mode 'hidden') or show.
When on foot (gameplay_walk.isWalking), the arrow rises by 1 m when the camera is within 4 m of the marker.
The arrow is a TSStatic named cylinder_marker_left<id> added to ScenarioObjectsGroup, with useInstanceRenderData.
The update method actually has the signature (dt, dtSim); the extracted page shows (dtSim) because of the ':' declaration.
The setToCheckpoint comment describes modes (default, branch, next, lap, finish, start) that this marker does not use.

init.desc: Constructor: initializes the state (invisible, mode 'hidden', height smoother).

update.desc: Per-frame call. Hides the marker once the fade is finished in 'hidden' mode, turns the arrow toward the camera (core_camera.getPosition), makes it oscillate and applies the color.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places the marker on a checkpoint.

setMode.desc: Changes the mode: 'hidden' hides, any other mode shows. Resets the color timer to zero.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic object (shapeName, instance color, not saveable) registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup if it exists.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates the arrow.

clearMarkers.desc: Removes the objects created by this marker.
